title: 番外篇·一
slug: 废土藏身处从下水道开始升级
content_zh:
“我听到了，5号门也有动静，看来这次我们有得玩了！渊子。”耳机中传来队友的声音。
于渊轻笑：“我们不着急，牛哥就在我的左手边，等他们先打就好，只要开打，我们就可以开吃。”
他更是凭借对地图和游戏的了解，极度痴迷于跑刀这种极度刺激，却能以小搏大的玩法。
“哈哈，笑死我了，这是两个全装新人啊！全跪了……”耳机传来同伴幸灾乐祸的笑声。
两人当即不再隐藏，熟练地将牛哥干掉，又将紧随其后刷新出来的KALL干掉。
content_en:
"I heard it. There was movement at Gate 5. It seems we have something to play this time! Yuanzi." The voice of a teammate came from the headset.
Yu Yuan chuckled: "We are not in a hurry. Brother Niu is on my left. Just wait for them to fight first. As soon as the fight starts, we can start eating."
Relying on his understanding of maps and games, he is extremely obsessed with the extremely exciting gameplay of knife running, but he can win big with small things.
"Haha, I'm laughing so hard. These are two newlyweds in full costume! They're both kneeling..." The gloating laughter of my companions came from the headphones.
The two immediately stopped hiding and skillfully killed Brother Niu, and then killed KALL who spawned immediately after him.
